(of Clark County, Nevada)

COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE (CDAC) AND

MATTERS PROVIDED HEREIN.
THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS OF THE COUNTY OF CLARK,
STATE OF NEVADA, DOES HEREBY ORDAIN AS FOLLOWS:
Section 1. Title 3, Chapter 3.68, of the Clark County Code is hereby amended as follows:
3.68.010 Created — General provisions.
There is created the community development advisory committee. The membership of the
committee shall consist of one £1) representative from each city that participates with Clark
County in an urban county consortium defined by 24 CFR 92.101, or successor provisions;
and one (1) representative from each county commission district on e r e pr e s e ntativ e from
e ach unincorporat e d town in Clark County; on e r e pr e s e ntativ e from e ach ar e a s e rv e d by a
citiz e ns advisory council; — and fourt ee n at larg e m e mb e rs . The board of county
commissioners shall designate the chair and vice chair of the committee.
3.68.030 Members generally.
The members of the committee representing each city shall be appointed by the governing
body of the respective cities , recognized by the board of county commissioners, and shall
be non-voting members. The seven (7) at-large members of the committee shall be
appointed by the board of county commissioners , one for each of the seven (7) commission
